title: Header Contract Model
prompt: Model a multi-file project in one file: implement `int add(int, int)` (the "math_utils.cpp" definition), a `bool declared_only(int)` that must exist so the "main.cpp" side links (declare-and-define pattern), and `int call_add(int, int)` which calls `add` through its declaration-style usage. Then fix the classic bug: `kMaxRetries` must be a shared constant usable from "several files" — define it correctly for a header.

tests.name: add works
tests.hint: The definition side of the contract.

tests.name: declared_and_defined
tests.hint: A function that exists so the other file's call links.

tests.name: call through
tests.hint: Calls add — the linking pattern in miniature.

tests.name: header constant
tests.hint: inline constexpr at namespace scope: one shared definition, no ODR problem.
